author: CollinRugg
text:
Golden Retriever brings his toy to a home intruder after the man broke into the home in San Diego, CA.

The 'watch' dog, Nash, watched the home intruder make himself at home and even tried to get the man to play with him. 

The dog's owner, who wasn't home, says he watched the entire scene unfold on his phone.

"Nash is not the greatest guard dog. We thought he was going to be barking at people, and he did the exact opposite."
